simple.meaning: נְבָא (nᵉbâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “prophesy.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 5:1. The surrounding contexts include family line, prophetic witness, Israel.

occurrences.englishText: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.
